Coverage

Unichain, Uniswap’s rollup. This is separate from Uniswap on L1; execution on Unichain itself is L2 gas and is excluded. Identified Ethereum batch submissions, settlement proposals, canonical bridge activity, selected approvals and chain-specific Across/CCTP transfers. Shared Superchain governance, dynamic dispute-game calls and unresolved routes are excluded.

Execution gas divided by 21,000. This compares gas demand, not transaction usefulness.
